title: ml_inference decision playground frontend scene and kea logic
answers: Where is the decision playground logic?
How does the playground call the decide API?
How is the playground scene gated?
body:
- frontend/DecisionPlaygroundScene.tsx: `scene: SceneExport` binds component to decisionPlaygroundLogic; gated on FEATURE_FLAGS.ML_INFERENCE_DECISIONS or preflight.is_debug; QuestionRow/OptionRow helpers; DecisionAnswerCell.tsx renders an answer.
- frontend/decisionPlaygroundLogic.ts: pure helpers buildDecideRequest, questionsToJson, questionsFromJson, EXAMPLE_STATE/EXAMPLE_QUESTIONS. Kea logic connects teamLogic.currentTeamId; loader `decision.askDecision` calls generated mlInferenceDecisionsDecideCreate with selector requestBody. Reducers: state, questions, askedQuestions, questionsView, questionsJson. Selectors: requestBody, questionsJsonError, askDisabledReason.
- Listeners: askDecision snapshots askedQuestions (answers labeled with asked questions); setQuestionsView serializes to JSON; setQuestionsJson parses valid JSON into questions.
- Tests: decisionPlaygroundLogic.test.ts.
